language_reviews.scope: 28 frozen live personal/action cases. Read-only review; no provider retries, no source edits, and no claim of qualified teacher review.
common_findings: All28 sampled source passages exhibit appropriate sampled noun/adjective case or verb forms; the second handover sample is redundant rather than ungrammatical.

Permission questions are well formed. Assessment asks intended object, not whether permission was granted; the source never supplies a grant.

Three permission requests are grammatical, clear and separately attributed. Repetition is appropriate for a brief novice discrimination task, but not evidence of natural conversational flow.

language_reviews.scope: 24 frozen targeted live responses, read-only review of original requests, raw sources, questions and rendered feedback. No API calls. This is not a qualified tutor review or a new success-rate sample.
conclusions: Structural acceptance did not imply language quality: samples06/12/13/20 expose scope and plausibility problems.
Exact contiguous phrases also rejected sound Russian: noun ellipsis10/11 and predicative order21. Treat these as validator defects, not low model language quality.
Sample24 pronoun reference is unambiguous; initials/name morphology needs filtering.
Future imperfective remains an activity without a promised result. No result should be inferred simply from будет читать.
Short three-fact passages serve narrow early A1 comprehension; they are not full discourse or three independent mastery observations.
Personal and relation hint fragments are substantially clearer than the first batch. Remaining minor aspect/temporal-focus wording is noted in01/02.

notes: Completed reading, not-yet-reading and tomorrow’s reading activity remain distinct; no imperfective-future completion claim.

Question Что Анна делала вчера? is less precise than asking whether she had read the letter, since the correct option says what she had not done. Russian hint for future uses сделать despite IP reading; prefer делать for that hint. These are pedagogical copy improvements, not source grammar errors.
Usual walking and today’s train trip are explicit. Neutral направляется in the destination question does not reveal the walking/vehicle answer.
Hint как передвигается Миша is broader than the usual journey question; adding обычно would preserve the intended temporal focus.
Анна была в Омске неделю and Там был и Олег correctly distinguish duration, place and another participant. No residence implication from жил.
Working now explains no current call; completion of work triggers later call to sister. Pronoun она has a clear named referent.
Когда работа закончится, она потом позвонит is understandable but потом is redundant after когда.

samples.validation_reason: Unfamiliar passage words need contextual support: звонит
notes: Same sound cause/trigger relationship as04. Missing context support for звонит is the structural failure, not a grammatical error.
Теперь/потом redundancy can be reduced without changing facts.

Вера предлагает встретиться позже, в семь, потому что ещё работает, в музее places в музее after the reason clause. It can describe where she works rather than where to meet. The last comma does not establish a reliable venue relation.
Do not grade в музее as the meeting venue from this sentence. Attach location to встретиться in one main clause before the because clause.
Second sentence explicitly binds seven o’clock and museum to the proposed meeting. Source supports all three answers.
Repeated Вера предлагает встретиться позже is mechanical; combine the time and venue into the first proposal or use an ordinary brief follow-up.

samples.validation_reason: The cited passage must preserve the planned predicate and its grammatical form.
notes: Миша сейчас учитель; Анна занимается музыкой; В будущем Анна будет учителем are grammatical and internally consistent.

Frozen plan requires Anna’s own stated future intention, Анна говорит: «... я буду ...». Generated unqualified narrator future removes that viewpoint and fails the exact predicate contract. Distinguish this contract rejection from bad Russian.
занимается русским языком/спортом uses correct instrumental. Vera’s direct statement буду врачом establishes her own future plan rather than inferred career from hobby.

samples.validation_reason: The passage must realize every planned answer.
notes: У Оли белая шапка, а у Ивана красная is standard recoverable noun ellipsis. Whose hat has which colour remains unambiguous.
Rejected only because correct answer красная шапка is not contiguous. Morphology/owner-aware ellipsis support should accept it.

samples.validation_reason: The passage must realize every planned answer.
notes: Same legitimate noun ellipsis as10 in a listening address to Oleg. No omitted semantic fact; do not require unnatural repetition of шапка just for a substring validator.
Миша здесь: Анна даёт ему телефон has a recoverable dative pronoun and grammatical handover.
Потом Оля здесь, и Анна звонит ей is stilted, gives no reason to phone someone present, and weakens the purpose of the activity. A receiver who is elsewhere is a better event constraint.
Object reference is grammatical: видит Мишу и даёт ему телефон. она refers to Anna; ей refers to Olya.

Потом она видит Олю и звонит ей is physically possible at a distance, but no such setting is given. In this simple scenario the phone call is unmotivated; do not add incidental seeing solely to establish a pronoun antecedent.
журнал Миши, сейчас он у Лены distinguishes ownership from temporary holding. Он refers to masculine журнал, not a second person. Telephone owner is separate.
Singular reader and coordinated plural speakers are accurate. По-русски now has supplied support. No cross-question name leak.
Сначала Оля / потом Иван establishes order; Вера speaks Russian. All person alternatives remain parallel. Sentence is concise and clear for early listening.
Его зовут Иван / её зовут Нина correctly link names and gender. Repeat request names the information requested rather than supplying a fabricated answer.
Rendered authored hints now preserve names and use grammatical English fragments.
о маме is a person topic, о музыке a thing/topic, в кафе a stationary location. All facts have straightforward evidence and governed prepositions.
его/её/их refer clearly to named singular and shared owners.
Олег и Нина вместе: это их журнал is understandable but mechanically engineered. Natural introduction of the people followed by Это их журнал would read better.
А это их журнал: Олег и Нина is not a sound attribution of ownership. After журнал the nominative names look like a malformed appositive or a journal title.
Introduce both owners separately or use их общий журнал. Do not accept mere occurrence of two expected names as evidence of coherent attribution.

samples.validation_reason: The passage must realize every planned answer.
notes: У Димы ... а сумка синяя is correct predicative adjective order with inherited owner. It means the bag is blue; there is no missing fact.
Contiguous синяя сумка test creates a false rejection. Use owner-aware agreement validation permitting noun/adjective order variation.
All three clothing descriptions have correct feminine/masculine adjective agreement; distractors change colour and preserve form. Clear but minimal list-based comprehension.
Анна named before Она, explicit thinking quote and current park location are unambiguous. Speaking about a friend does not imply thinking about the same topic.

samples.validation_reason: The cited subject pronoun has an ambiguous named antecedent.
notes: Анна ... «Я думаю о семье». Сейчас она в парке has one feminine personal referent. Олег is a masculine addressee; capital Я is a pronoun, not a second woman.
False ambiguity came from pymorphy Name/Abbr/Init alternatives for Я. Excluding initials/abbreviations from inferred names fixes the validator without changing passage prose.

language_reviews.scope: 24 fresh synthetic scripts after the first frozen68 run. Language reviewed as text only; no audio, browser playback, learner trial or external certification.
language_reviews.reviewer: AI language/implementation review. See independent-language-review.json for a separate agent’s assessment.
limitations: The presence guard enforces this scenario’s declared no-extra-encounter policy; it conservatively excludes some otherwise valid Russian prose.
Description realization supports narrow owner-linked attributive/predicative order and uniquely recoverable parallel ellipsis. It is not a general Russian entailment parser.
Short A1 passages still vary in narrative naturalness; structural acceptance is not proof of idiomatic prose.

samples.observation: прочитал до конца, ещё не читала and будет читать preserve completed reading, no earlier reading and a future activity without promising completion.
Обычно ходит пешком versus сегодня едет на поезде preserves habitual walking versus today’s vehicle journey. Today’s destination is explicit. Repeating Миша is minor prose stiffness.
Была в Омске неделю uses a completed stay and an accusative duration. Там был и Олег clearly places the second person in the same city.
The reason and end-trigger concern the same work activity, and the call recipient is explicit. Repeated сейчас and потом after когда are unnecessary but do not change the meaning.
The call relation is grammatically sound, but required contextual support for звонит is missing. The final validator still rejects this raw output.

samples.observation: Это журнал Миши, но сейчас он у Лены explicitly distinguishes owner from current holder. The separate phone has a different owner.
Олег читает versus Анна и Лена говорят correctly preserves singular/plural conjugation and the separate reader/pair. По-русски is now explicitly supported.
Сначала читает Оля, потом читает Иван separates order without introducing a new tense; по-русски говорит Вера names a distinct third action.
Его зовут Иван and её зовут Нина establish names; the polite Повторите время request is explicit and does not imply changing the time.
О маме / о музыке contrasts a person and a topic using the appropriate prepositional forms. Дима’s café location is explicit.

Его, её and их have explicit named referents. Олег и Нина вместе is an artificial introduction to shared ownership, but the possessive statement itself is clear; this is a prose-quality limit, not a case error.

method.reference_body: Join deduplicated checked_source_frame_ru strings. Fall back to mandatory fact value_ru for the original three plans lacking checked frames.
method.unfamiliar_words: Run production unfamiliar_content with no new_vocabulary annotations. Count a minimum cover of possible_lemmas; morphology does not choose a sense.
method.support_entries: Count unresolved word occurrences outside actual supported-phrase spans, plus unique actual used_phrases entries.
limitations: Reference-frame feasibility is not a full generated passage, prose-quality or assessment-validity test.
Over-budget reference wording can be rephrased; it does not prove the communicative task is impossible.
The original three units have only a mandatory fact-value bound, not a full-passage guarantee.
Real generated connectors, greetings, repeated unknown words and alternative senses can add support needs.
The morphology minimum is permissive for homographs; contextual glosses and grammatical meaning still require validation.
